data.name: Sprocket.AutoClose.Slider
data.comment: The name of a slider in a door's terminal that sets how long the door stays open before it closes by itself.

data.name: Sprocket.AutoClose.SliderAbout
data.value: Closes the door by itself this long after it finishes opening. All the way to the left is off.
data.comment: The tooltip on the slider in a door's terminal that sets how long the door stays open before it closes by itself.

data.name: Sprocket.AutoClose.Off
data.comment: The value shown beside the slider in a door's terminal that sets how long the door stays open, when it is all the way to the left and the door never closes by itself.
